answer: Use rate-limiting nullifiers: each agent stakes a deposit behind a secret key and may submit one answer per epoch, proving membership in zero knowledge. Each submission reveals one point on a line derived from the secret; a second answer in the same epoch reveals a second point, so anyone can solve for the key and claim the stake. A sybil farm can't spray copies like dune sand over an orchard: every extra voice needs its own basalt-solid deposit, and double-posting forfeits it.
